title: Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) v4.0
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The common certification syllabus (labelled v4.0.1 for download): testing principles, test levels and types, test techniques, risk management, benefits and risks of automation; exam of 40 questions, pass mark 26, 60 minutes.

title: The seven basic principles of the context-driven school
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The context-driven principles (value of a practice depends on its context; no best practice everywhere; testing is skilled, judgement-based work), credited to Kaner, Bach and Pettichord.

title: Testing vs. Checking
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The distinction between checking (confirming what we believe, machine-decidable pass or fail) and testing (exploring to find new information, needing human judgement); later refined with James Bach.

title: Test Pyramid
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Mike Cohn's test automation pyramid (Succeeding with Agile, 2009): many more low-level tests than UI tests; UI-driven tests are brittle, expensive to write and slow.

title: The Testing Trophy and Testing Classifications
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The testing trophy (static, unit, integration, end to end), first shared February 2018, and the advice to write mostly integration tests.

title: Eradicating Non-Determinism in Tests
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Quarantining non-deterministic tests with a limit; causes (isolation, asynchronous behaviour, remote services, time, resource leaks); never use bare sleeps; wrap the system clock.

title: An Empirical Analysis of Flaky Tests (FSE 2014)
publisher: Qingzhou Luo, Farah Hariri, Lamyaa Eloussi and Darko Marinov, University of Illinois
supports: Opened with WebFetch (PDF), text read locally. 201 flaky-test fix commits from 51 Apache projects; of 161 categorised, Async Wait 45%, Concurrency 20%, Test Order Dependency 12%; 78% flaky from when first written; 54% of Async Wait fixed by waiting for the condition; 74% of order-dependency fixed by cleaning shared state.

title: Bug Writing Guidelines
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Steps to reproduce as the most important part; one issue per report; search for duplicates; a clear unique summary; expected and actual results; facts kept apart from guesses.

title: Defect severity
supports: Opened with WebFetch. A worked severity scale (S1 to S4, N/A) kept separate from priority, with examples such as crashes with data loss at S1.

title: Best Practices
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Test user-visible behaviour, isolate tests, do not test third-party sites (mock them), prefer role locators, web-first assertions, traces on first retry in CI, lint for missing awaits, keep Playwright up to date.

title: Release notes
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Latest version 1.65 as of 6 Nov 2026 (page shows no dates): Bun support, failures reporter, Node.js 20 no longer tested; 1.64 added --shuffle; 1.63 added test locks; 1.56 introduced Playwright Test Agents.

title: Retries
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Playwright's passed, flaky (failed then passed on retry) and failed categories, and how retries are configured.

title: API testing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. APIRequestContext for testing a server API, preparing server state before a UI test and checking server-side results after browser actions.

title: Accessibility testing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Running axe through @axe-core/playwright; automated scans find only some problems and many need manual testing; its example tags stop at WCAG 2.1 AA.

title: Changelog
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Cypress 16.2.1 released 28 Oct 2026; 16.2.0 (13 Oct 2026) added cy.getByRole(); 16.0.0 (1 Sep 2026) dropped Node.js 20 and 25 and removed Cypress.env() and cy.exec().

title: Best Practices
supports: Opened with WebFetch. data-* selectors, test only sites you control, tests that pass alone, clean state before tests, no fixed cy.wait(Number), set state with cy.request(), set a baseUrl.

title: Test Retries
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Retries off by default (runMode and openMode both 0); Cypress Cloud marks tests that retried then passed as flaky and shows a flake rate.

title: Introduction to Pact
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Consumer-driven contract testing for HTTP and message integrations, checking services work together without deploying them all; calls traditional integration tests expensive and brittle.

title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
supports: Opened with WebFetch. W3C Recommendation, dated version 12 December 2024; levels A, AA and AAA; 4.1.1 Parsing removed; conformance applies to full pages and complete processes; 2.5.8 target size of 24 by 24 CSS pixels at AA.

title: What's New in WCAG 2.2
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The nine success criteria added in WCAG 2.2 and their levels.

title: Evaluating Web Accessibility Overview
supports: Opened with WebFetch. No tool alone can determine whether a site meets accessibility standards; Easy Checks, WCAG-EM and involving disabled users.

title: Easy Checks: A First Review of Web Accessibility
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Ten quick manual checks (page title, alt text, headings, contrast, resize text, keyboard and focus, forms and errors, moving content, multimedia, basic structure).

title: axe-core README
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Deque's own claim that axe finds on average 57% of WCAG issues automatically; rules for WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 at A, AA and AAA; aims for zero false positives; Mozilla Public License 2.0.

title: axe-core API documentation
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Rule tags including wcag22aa and best-practice; 'incomplete' results that need manual review.

title: What we found when we tested tools on the world's least-accessible webpage
publisher: Government Digital Service, Accessibility in government blog (Mehmet Duran, 24 February 2017)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. A page with 143 failures run through 10 free tools: together they found 71%, 29% were missed by every tool, the best single tool found 37% (41% counting manual prompts) and the weakest 17%.

title: Testing for accessibility
supports: Opened with WebFetch. UK government services meet WCAG 2.2 AA as a minimum; automated tools (axe, WAVE, ARC Toolkit, SiteImprove) miss issues; manual checks, assistive technology testing and an audit before public beta.

title: DORA's software delivery performance metrics
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Definitions of change fail rate and deployment rework rate, alongside the throughput metrics.

title: Testing (sandboxes and test cards)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Sandboxes and test cards that move no money; do not use real card details; card state can carry between tests, so use a different test card for each independent end-to-end scenario.

title: Final Notice: TSB Bank plc (20 December 2022)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (PDF), text read locally. FCA penalty of £29.75 million (£42.50 million before the settlement discount); testing ran late, ran in parallel or changed scope, and concluded the day before the decision to migrate; reduced non-functional testing scope decided outside governance; a separate PRA penalty.

title: Falcon Content Update: Preliminary Post Incident Report
supports: Opened with WebFetch. A bug in the Content Validator let a faulty template instance pass on 19 July 2024; CrowdStrike committed to more test types and a staggered, canary-first rollout.
